summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Minh Lâm batch (inquiries, admin auth, Google session, product upload, Contact map). 21/21 pytest cases pass against external preview URL. Frontend flows verified via Playwright: Contact form → admin login → /admin/inquiries with data appearing, search, status update+toast, filter, mobile responsive, logout redirects and re-auth is enforced.

issues: Google Maps iframe uses address-based ?q=... geocoding; pin accuracy of '389 Cù Chính Lan, Hoà Bình, Phú Thọ' is not empirically verified — disclaimer already shown to user, acceptable.

action_items: Owner (nbngoc128@gmail.com) still needs to complete a real Google sign-in end-to-end — only allowlist and invalid-session negative paths were tested here (no live OAuth consent performed).
Verify actual Google Maps pin at 389 Cù Chính Lan matches showroom in production; if wrong, switch REACT_APP_SHOWROOM_MAP_URL to a `!1m..!3d..!4d..` place-embed once lat/lng known.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_admin: JWT decode failure silently falls through — acceptable, but logging jwt.PyJWTError at debug would speed future auth debugging.
AdminInquiries.tsx pages count is hard-coded to page_size=20 (Math.ceil(total/20)); if backend page_size changes it will desync. Read query.data.page_size instead.

AdminInquiries.tsx mutation onSuccess decrements page based on `status !== 'all'`, but the mutated inquiry may still match filter after update (e.g. new→contacted while filter=contacted); logic can prematurely paginate back. Minor UX edge case, not blocking.

server.py CORS `allow_origins=os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*').split(',')` combined with `allow_credentials=True` is invalid per spec when origin is '*'; browsers will drop cookies. Currently .env has `CORS_ORIGINS=*`. Should be tightened to explicit https origin(s) for production correctness — cookies happen to work here because same-origin via ingress rewrite.
Contact.tsx uses `process.env.REACT_APP_SHOWROOM_MAP_URL` directly in JSX; if the env var is ever undefined the iframe src becomes 'undefined' silently. Add a fallback or invariant.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_minhlam_regression.py. IMPORTANT: pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope xdist workers; auth cookies are set with secure=True samesite=none so cookies only persist over https — run with `BACKEND_URL=<REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL> pytest -n 0` when doing serial debugging. Frontend routes: /contact (not /lien-he), admin nav testids: admin-nav-inquiries, admin-logout. Google Maps iframe uses address search (?q=…&output=embed) — do not assert exact geographic pin.
rca of the issue: None; no bugs reproduced. Initial pytest run failed with 401s only because tests targeted http://localhost:8001 where secure cookies are dropped by httpx — switching BACKEND_URL to the external https preview URL resolved it.
